tar-czf.text: Pack the directory `~/{{documents}}` into the compressed archive `~/{{documents}}.tar.gz`.
tar-czf.hint: Go to your home directory and use *create zipped verbose file*: `tar -czvf {{documents}}.tar.gz {{documents}}`.

tar-t.text: List the contents of `~/{{documents}}.tar.gz` – without unpacking it.

tar-x.text: Create the directory `~/{{unpacked}}` and unpack `~/{{documents}}.tar.gz` into it.
tar-x.hint: With `-C` you choose where tar unpacks: `tar -xzvf ~/{{documents}}.tar.gz -C ~/{{unpacked}}`.

gzip.text: Copy `~/{{documents}}/server.log` to your home directory and compress the copy with `gzip`, so that you get `~/server.log.gz`.

zcat.text: Show the lines containing `ERROR` in `~/server.log.gz` – without unpacking the file.
zcat.hint: `zcat` prints the contents of a .gz file. Pipe it into `grep`.

zip.text: Install the `zip` and `unzip` packages, and then pack `~/{{documents}}` into `~/{{documents}}.zip`.
zip.hint: Run `sudo apt update` and `sudo apt install zip unzip`. Don't forget `-r` for zip: `zip -r {{documents}}.zip {{documents}}`.

unzip.text: Unpack `~/{{documents}}.zip` into the new directory `~/{{fromZip}}` with `unzip`.
unzip.hint: `-d` chooses the directory and creates it if it's missing: `unzip ~/{{documents}}.zip -d ~/{{fromZip}}`.
